name: Speech (AmberX speaks: text-to-speech, reading queue, spoken controls)
description: The speaking side of speech@1 (listening stays in lib-voice). Registers Android TextToSpeech as the kernel's axf.speech provider (AndroidTtsProvider: voices, rate, pitch, language, utterance callbacks as queue events), one SpeechPlayer per app that runs the kernel SpeechQueue reducer (enqueue, pause, resume, skip, faster, slower, repeat, stop) with audio focus and ducking, a Speech settings group (read aloud, voice, speed, pitch, language, ducking) and the reader's spoken controls as actions + permanent voice triggers in the kernel TriggerRegistry ("pause", "resume", "skip", "faster", "slower", "repeat", "stop reading"). lib-voice's Speaker runs on it. Web twin: framework/core/speech-web.ts (WebSpeechProvider + SpeechPlayer).

android.note: written without a compiler; CI compiles and runs :lib-speech:testDebugUnitTest

placeholders.note: High-quality (neural / cloud) voices — HqSpeechProvider is a typed placeholder; not built.
